ticker: US FAA Lifts Nationwide Flight Ground Stop
Trump, Xi, and Putin Plan Trilateral Meeting
Delhi Becomes World's Most Polluted City
Oil Tankers Explode Near Strait of Hormuz

articles.headline: US FAA Lifts Nationwide Flight Ground Stop After Outage
articles.brief: The US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop that halted thousands of flights due to an air traffic control communications outage. Officials confirmed no cyberattack occurred, though lingering delays are expected to impact travelers through the weekend.

articles.headline: Microsoft Fully Restores Global Cloud and Office Services
articles.brief: Microsoft announced the full restoration of services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications, ending a massive global tech outage that disrupted major businesses and government agencies for more than 24 hours.

articles.headline: Trump to Discuss Nuclear Arms Cuts with Putin and Xi
articles.brief: The White House announced that US President Donald Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit to discuss nuclear-arms reductions and geopolitical stability.

articles.headline: Delhi Overtakes Lahore as World's Most Polluted City
articles.brief: Air quality levels in India's capital plummeted, pushing Delhi past Lahore to become the world's most polluted city as hazardous smog blankets the region.

articles.headline: Two Oil Tankers Explode Near Strait of Hormuz
articles.brief: Two oil tankers reportedly exploded and caught fire after striking naval mines near the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, escalating security concerns across global energy markets.

articles.headline: India's October Trade Deficit Hits One-Year High
articles.brief: India reported an October trade deficit widening to a one-year high of $39.88 billion, driven primarily by a significant surge in gold imports.

articles.headline: David Warner Makes Explosive Claim on Ball Tampering Probe
articles.brief: In a new development regarding the 2018 Cape Town ball-tampering scandal, Australian cricketer David Warner claimed that Cricket Australia failed to interview several key bowlers during its investigation.

articles.headline: Amazon Plan to Fight AI Shopping Agents Exposed
articles.brief: Internal reports reveal Amazon's strategic blueprint to secure global product data and build defenses against emerging AI shopping agents threatening traditional e-commerce models.

articles.headline: India Orders Strict Audit of Electronic Waste Recyclers
articles.brief: The Indian government has ordered a comprehensive nationwide audit of electronic waste recycling facilities to crack down on fake compliance and illegal processing practices.

articles.headline: US Loses Measles Elimination Status Amid Surge in Cases
articles.brief: Public health reports indicate that the United States has lost its official measles elimination status following persistent transmission and surging case numbers over the past year.

articles.headline: BYD Launches Luxury Brand Denza in Indian Market
articles.brief: Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD has officially launched its luxury brand Denza in India, positioning itself to compete directly against established luxury automakers like Mercedes and Toyota.

articles.headline: India Honors Duty Cuts on Scotch Whisky Imports from UK
articles.brief: Government officials confirmed that India will honor scheduled tariff and duty reductions on Scotch whisky imports originating from the United Kingdom under ongoing trade discussions.
